faces.name: The Sabertooth Wizard
faces.oracleText:
Each legendary creature you control gets +1/+1 for each legendary creature you control whose name begins with "The."
Whenever The Sabertooth Wizard attacks, mill cards equal to its power. Then choose a creature or planeswalker card in your graveyard whose name begins with "The." You may pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}. If you do, return it to the battlefield. If you don't, return it to your hand. If you can't choose a creature card this way, create a Treasure token.

faces.name: The Sackville-Bagginses
faces.oracleText:
When The Sackville-Bagginses enter, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, draw a card and create a Treasure token.
Whenever you sacrifice a token, target opponent loses 1 life.

faces.name: The Sad Creaturez
faces.oracleText:
Creatures that haven't shared their feelings can't attack or block.
All creatures have "{2}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. You gain 1 life. This creature shares its feelings. Activate only as a sorcery. (Creatures can continue to share their feelings.)"
{T}: Add two mana of any one color.

faces.name: The Salubrious Philosopher
faces.oracleText: If you would draw a card, you may instead choose mana base, removal, or win condition and reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a card of the chosen kind. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. (Mana base cards add mana. Removal cards are instants and sorceries that can damage, destroy, or exile opposing permanents. Win conditions cost 6 or more mana.)

faces.name: The Savant
faces.oracleText: Exile The Savant: Tap all creatures your opponents control. Those creatures don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.

faces.name: The Sayer of Don't
faces.oracleText:
({Z} is rainbow mana, one mana from any source that could add two or more colors of mana. This card is all colors.)
Whenever you cast a spell, if rainbow mana was spent to cast it, put a don't counter on The Sayer of Don't.
Remove two counters from The Sayer of Don't: Counter target spell.

faces.name: The Scarab God
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, each opponent loses X life and you scry X, where X is the number of Zombies you control.
{2}{U}{B}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie.
When The Scarab God dies, return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.

faces.name: The Scarlet Witch
faces.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you cast with mana value 4 or greater cost {X} less to cast, where X is The Scarlet Witch's power.
